- **Interface:** `markdown.Service` in `internal/markdown/markdown.go` (lines 31–55).
- **Only concrete impl:** unexported `service` (lines 57–60); comment at line 57: `// service implements the Service interface.`
- **Runtime construction:** one `*service` is created in `NewAPIV1Service` (`server/router/api/v1/v1.go`, lines 47–51). `server.NewServer` (`server/server.go`, lines 76–85) creates that service and passes its `MarkdownService` field into `rss.NewRSSService`.
